A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS
Curious?
 Good. So are we.
Talk to a human 
What can I get from Mindcase?
Structured web data from 25+ sources, with 84 APIs for specific tasks. Explore people and companies, local businesses, products, reviews, social posts, and more in the API library.
Do I need to write code?
You can make REST API calls, give the documentation to a coding agent, or connect a compatible AI client through MCP. Pick the approach that fits your workflow.
How does MCP connect to my agent?
Add https://mcp.mindcase.co/ as a remote MCP server in your supported client. Authenticate with OAuth where supported, or use your Mindcase API key. MCP uses the same prepaid wallet as the API.
Do my credits expire?
No. Add credit to your prepaid wallet and use it when you need data. Each API has a price per record, with no recurring plan or per-seat fee.
Need a source that isn't in the library?
The Mindcase team can help with custom sources, more involved data pipelines, and managed runs. Share what you need and discuss the right approach for your project.
